activities.title: Many Maybes 01: A few marks, many possibilities
activities.description: Turn two circles, an arc and a stroke into an object, a place or a scene. Keep the original marks and explore new meanings with a free printable drawing challenge.

steps.text: Fixed starter: two unequal circles, an open arc and a detached stroke. Turn two circles, an arc and a stroke into an object, a place or a scene. Keep the original marks and explore new meanings with a free printable drawing challenge. Look at the starter, or picture it from the description. Look away if you like and imagine what these marks could become. Keep the original marks in place. What would you add?
Have an idea you like? You can talk it through and record it, or dictate a written note. Review your idea before choosing to submit it to Many Maybes. Sharing is optional.
Keep your possibility, or try another.
